title: ech-errand config (ERRAND_ROUTER_CONFIG)
description: Every key is optional. A missing or unreadable file means the generic defaults.

lanes.description: Lane key to description. Replaces the generic lane table in Jev mode.

how.description: The Jev HOW text. Replaces the generic one.

sshHosts.description: Hosts whose `ssh <host> ...` calls count as errands (Jev mode).

liveRunWords.description: Script names whose `node ... <word>` call, run over ssh, stays in the main thread (Jev mode).

enforce.description: Enforce mode. In a session whose cwd is one of these projects (or inside one) the hook runs in block mode with no holdout group.

projects.description: Absolute project directories. Relative entries never match.
